grounding.excerpt:
FOR THE DRAFT NATIONAL POLLUTANT DISCHARGE ELIMINATION SYSTEM
(NPDES) PERMIT TO DISCHARGE TO WATERS OF THE UNITED STATES

PERMIT ACTION

Proposed revocation and reissuance of the current permit issued with an effective date of June 1,
2016, and an expiration date of May 31, 2021.

rationale: The packet establishes that the fact sheet header labels the materials as a DRAFT NPDES permit and that the permit action is proposed (not final). That supports that this document presents preliminary permit materials as of March 2021. It does not establish whether those conditions remained preliminary or became final enforceable terms, nor what permit governed discharge limits and monitoring during Federal FY2025 (2024-10-01 through 2025-09-30). The cited permit expired May 31, 2021, and the packet contains no issuance/finalization record, superseding permit, or FY2025 applicability linkage. Without evidence connecting the DRAFT label to enforceability during FY2025, neither ACCEPT (that DRAFT indicates preliminary rather than final enforceable terms for FY2025) nor REJECT (that it does not) can be grounded; UNRESOLVED is the supported outcome.
